messages:
lina.p: kicking off CloudSpark co-marketing sprint — goal: marketplace listing + joint webinar in two weeks. need fast owners for landing, registration routing, and post-webinar assets.
omar.gtm: i can build the landing + registration. propose Wed 11am PT or Thu 9am PT. 40m slot: 12m demo / 10m customer story / 12m q&a / 6m CTAs.
tess.prod: i'll own the demo and the benchmark narrative. request to eng for conservative latency + cost deltas, labeled as 'internal benchmark, customer results may vary'.
cloudspark.reps: we can provide co-branded hero, 1-sentence quote, and a 15-30s clip. ETA: 2026-04-18 EOD. sending SVG and PNG.
omar.gtm: registration form: name, company, role, company size (optional), use-case dropdown. map role->tag for routing: eng/platform => "technical_lead", product/ops => "pm_lead".
sam.opsbot: automation update: created Marketo list MKTO_CloudSpark_2026 and SFDC queue CloudSpark_Webinar_Apr. Sync job 8337 scheduled hourly.
lina.p: messaging ask: two hero lines — (1) technical variant and (2) executive variant. tess, can you include a short benchmark blurb to fit hero?
tess.prod: draft hero blurb: "Serve prod LLMs with predictable latency and savings — now listed on CloudSpark Market." i'll post a second exec-focused variant in 30m.
omar.gtm: AB test idea: two CTAs on landing — "Start a trial" vs "Book a private demo". 50/50 by cookie, same form. track utm_source=cloudspark_market and campaign=cs_partner_apr.
cloudspark.reps: legal confirmed co-marketing terms last week. will send final approved quote with logo.
tess.prod: rehearsal Friday 9am PT. demo will show Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private switch in a single flow <90s. will prepare a 1-pager with conservative % deltas for SDRs.
lina.p: post-webinar plan: publish blog with benchmark summary + transcript, chop 3 social clips (15s, 30s, 60s), and push repackaged benchmarks as a downloadable PDF. owners: blog=lina, socials=omar, one-pager=tess.
sam.opsbot: reminder: routing rule for sales ops ticket: if utm_source=="cloudspark_market" OR source=="cloudspark_listing" => add to MKTO_CloudSpark_2026 and assign CloudSpark_Webinar_Apr.
lina.p: perfect. i'll run a 15-min readiness check Wed morning. please surface any blocker before then. thanks everyone. :rocket:
